entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for User, Session, and Agent states. Available as a managed cloud or Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, it utilizes temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval to manage agent memory.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an AGPL-3.0 context database that organizes agent data using a viking:// URI virtual filesystem and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. It serves as an official Hermes provider, achieving significant token reduction and task-completion gains by extracting user preferences into long-term memory.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform provides AI agents with persistent long-term memory through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine. It builds these graphs from text, code, and session data, supporting memory storage and distillation across Python 3.10–3.14 environments.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph to extract typed entity relationships for multi-user institutional memory. It provides synthesized answers featuring explicit citations, gap analysis, and scoped data access for secure information retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, this engine features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and offers connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements a learnable memory system centered on retain, recall, and reflect workflows for long-term agent utility. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and multiple database backends via SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents by extracting reasoning-first conclusions from conversation history via a FastAPI server. It serves as the upstream library for Hermes-specific wrappers and supports deployment through managed hosting or local Docker instances.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: Byterover-cli manages memory as a git-like repository, providing version control features like branching and merging for markdown context trees. This official Hermes provider uses a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance across 20 different LLM providers.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This zero-dependency memory system operates locally using a single SQLite database file for sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression for sub-linear storage growth and supports the Model Context Protocol for integrations with Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: Memory-os implements a seven-layer memory system for Hermes, utilizing vector search on Qdrant and structured facts. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context and maintains an auto-curated wiki for persistent knowledge.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive harness helps agents succeed on complex tasks by iterating through executions to retain useful lessons and artifacts. It stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated promotion data directly in the filesystem, supporting both Python and TypeScript.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A dedicated plugin for Hermes Agent, this tool uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure lossless message persistence. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from their history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local session history from 25 different coding agents to enable millisecond lookups over months of past data. It processes up to 5 GB of history while automatically redacting keys and tokens during the indexing phase.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent through a Docker-based stack including PostgreSQL and Redis. It is compatible with any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference server.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to provide portable state across multiple agent clients. It supports real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub, achieving 97.6% average accuracy in LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur uses an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text files for local ownership and multi-agent sharing. It employs a hybrid search strategy combining BM25 and embeddings to facilitate local-first retrieval across MCP-compatible tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates entirely locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It integrates via MCP and agent hooks, utilizing a hybrid retrieval system that combines BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory offers a five-tier hierarchical schema backed by SQLite and FTS5 search without requiring vector databases or embedding models. The system is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and CLI.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization layer reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every recalled memory and includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments and handles canonicalization and contradiction tracking.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable context as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter. It runs local embedding models for hybrid BM25 and semantic search without telemetry or external databases.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for each agent query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally via SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that uses GGUF models to provide RAG and vector search capabilities.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It provides local-first memory persistence and session history tracking through MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This project provides reflective memory using automated indexing for codebases, URLs, and multimedia with OCR support. It utilizes semantic search via BM25 and ranked graph traversal, employing edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between stored notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed for Hermes Agent v0.14.0, this tool reduces prompt token overhead through local BM25 tool ranking and keyword selection. It includes a dedicated dashboard to track estimated schema token savings while maintaining compatibility with native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity, decisions, and workflows for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex using plain Markdown files. It features a source-neutral migration workflow for documents and chats to maintain context across different sessions.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories through importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction for structured memory retrieval.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin implements a pull-model that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation performed by the agent.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments using USDC and stablecoins across EVM, Solana, and eight other chain families. It allows APIs to charge for services and agents to pay for them directly into wallets with 0% fees.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin facilitates local capability indexing and routing by directing queries to skills, scripts, and MCP servers. It includes tools for neighbor traversal and knowledge retrieval, automatically generating tool routing notes via model calls.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots for state persistence. It relies on a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox to manage searching, remembering, and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This integration utilizes Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory, offering tools for both manual storage and automated searching. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the accuracy of retrieved information.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon, offering metadata filters and MinHash deduplication for long-term storage.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This project offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also performs automatic context checkpointing during message compression to preserve agent knowledge.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This toolkit provides a git-backed directory for versioned, diffable markdown memory managed through five specialized slash commands for capture and recall. It functions as a curation layer that identifies stale or conflicting data using 'rot' and 'lint' curators to propose evidence-cited updates.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution for Hermes. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating directly as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system provides Hermes with a CLI for generating web, mobile, and desktop prototypes featuring sandboxed iframe previews. It supports 26 local executables and allows for project exports in formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, offering a comprehensive security knowledge base for agentic workflows.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the conversion of natural language, SQL, and IaC into .drawio diagrams while preserving manual layout adjustments during updates. It also enforces architecture contracts through YAML/JSON rules and a Diagram-as-Test methodology.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router and connector for delegated permissions and dispute resolution. It includes vendored protocol skills to facilitate secure transactions and verification between agents.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and edit-in-place modes and is compatible with Hermes and agentskills.io agents.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a collective, evolving library that integrates with Hermes and OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring the evolution of agentic skills.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,169 skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent as plain markdown files. Distributed under the MIT license, it provides ready-to-paste exports for various AI assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows Hermes to perform video searches, browse channels, and extract transcripts or playlist data. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with multiple environments including OpenClaw and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing untrusted scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate them from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills transform rough concepts into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. The workflow features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and utilizes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to generate .lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files from documentation and automatically syncs source edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a harness for long-running agents that uses SQLite and Git for local-first session storage. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol for supervised teams and utilizes Markdown-based recipes for prompt-first working methods.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable agent discovery and interaction with smart contracts. The package supports integrations for CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian Hermes Agent community by providing installation guides and skills in Portuguese. All resources follow the SKILL.md format and the agentskills.io standard for compatibility.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide API integration and prompting guidelines for FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video models. The project includes a router to direct requests to specialized agents and supports BFL API features like webhooks and polling.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It manages skill lifecycles by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits for version-controlled exports.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io is a registry for reusable AI skills that supports installation with recursive dependency resolution. It provides a Python client and CLI, and includes commerce features utilizing TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a Rust-based workflow language that operates via a CLI using four verbs: infer, invoke, exec, and agent. It supports local-first processing and provides access to OpenAI API and Codex for model execution.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time tracking of decisions. It features built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during long-running operations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords, utilizing a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client implements a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It utilizes a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed for efficiency and includes graceful degradation paths if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and features federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: This personal execution OS uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to drive system design, scheduling, and habit tracking. Data is stored locally in a single SQLite file, accessible through both a React web application and an Expo-based Android app.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes agent communication by rewriting and scoring prompts across five quality dimensions for platforms like Discord, Telegram, and the CLI. It supports 97 languages and claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: Hermaguard performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings executed in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a trio of sub-agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify codebases. It supports five major programming languages and includes a risk-tiered application process with a mandatory approval gate.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It features a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop failures during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demos by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It optimizes GIF files to stay under 8 MB and handles the rendering, compression, and embedding process directly into the README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects frontmatter drift. It monitors official specifications weekly to ensure skills remain compliant with current runtime profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework enables agents to self-improve by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It ensures reliability by gating all updates behind deterministic, LLM-judge, and regression evaluators.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It operates with zero outbound telemetry and offers optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax and verifies project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables agents to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for listing bounties and buying context, with payments settled upon human approval.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides an MCP server that exposes 191 tools for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and OpenHands.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and produces structured reports containing core conclusions and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection of tools handles specialized media tasks such as converting Douyin links to Markdown and performing OCR on PDFs. It also features a utility to remove common Chinese AI writing patterns using local rules.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It supports both open-source and proprietary software binaries, offering a reliable way to manage development tool dependencies.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone provides an automated installer and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a single-command Termux installer that sets up Hermes Agent on Android with support for OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local Ollama models. It includes a gateway service and an interactive command-line interface for mobile operation.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates deploying Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks via cron jobs on mobile environments.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating agents on Docker and Kubernetes, featuring a 69-entry credential catalog and 17+ LLM provider integrations. It secures agent operations using AES-256-GCM encryption and mandatory encryption keys.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a Docker sandbox image that bundles the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It allows users to build specific Hermes tags and ensures persistent state through mounted home directories.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-based control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It supports inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This production-ready deployment uses systemd to run Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe service on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for headless operation and enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework simulates real-world trading firm dynamics using specialized LLM agents. It supports multiple providers, including Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, and features automated risk management evaluation with decision-log memory.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration system for governing agent registration, task dispatch, and cost tracking. It provides multiple interfaces, including a Web UI, CLI, REST API, and MCP server, with deployment options via Docker or Node.js.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and web control surface for managing various coding agents, such as Claude Code and Hermes Agent. It utilizes tmux for persistent background sessions and includes container-based isolation and Git worktree management.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A control room template that serves as the first MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain. It supports the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and detects HTTP signals to manage paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agents from single VPS instances to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms that supports over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenAI. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for managing team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board and live streams of reasoning. It implements human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across infrastructure, quality, implementation, planning, and research. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for task lifecycle management. It integrates ACP and MCP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring Kanban flows and agent dialogues.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TerminalBench-2 and TBLite evaluations while providing frontier tracking and structured candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena that orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It utilizes Hermes Agent and Paperclip for execution, with a real-time dashboard for tracking code and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: A fully-local framework that implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes and Ollama on consumer GPUs. It utilizes parallel model querying and synthesis for task routing and tool-calling without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for Hermes Agent by pre-indexing symbols and callers. It automatically updates the index during file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, via a Terminal User Interface. It allows developers to visualize their consumption and optionally submit data to a public leaderboard and profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by tool, model, and specific project sessions.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills to build and operate applications with Hermes Agent. It supports autonomous execution across both local laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel, allowing them to run natively without external processes or OAuth. It also introduces MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP, supporting providers like Anthropic and OpenAI. It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function for recent agent actions.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory adapters for platforms like Slack and VS Code, supporting frameworks such as the Claude Agent SDK. It utilizes a two-tier system consisting of knowledge graphs and session caches to enhance agent memory.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during Hermes Agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents that utilize per-folder configurations and skills. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides an automated installation for a hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, deterministic analysis of AI agent configurations and system prompts without requiring LLM or API calls. It identifies ambiguous tool descriptions and conflicting directives, supporting CI integration through SARIF output and baseline management.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and manages nested authentication structures during the migration process.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool exports real-time telemetry from agent conversations via a native Hermes plugin without cloud dependencies. It features passive analysis and active probing to detect performance drift relative to local configuration changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic, zero-network local runtime for Hermes Agent that requires explicit approval for external actions. It exposes its functionality through dynamic slash commands to help users build local agent applications.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: A voice-enabled assistant for Hermes Agent that offers offline operation with no API keys or accounts required. It supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking, barge-in capabilities, and wake-word activation.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports semantic search and multi-dimensional storage for agent interactions. It includes a circuit breaker for API outages and provides specific tools for adding, searching, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local coworking application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It supports remote access through WebUI and messaging platforms, offering 21 specialized assistants for document and presentation tasks.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web interface allows users to operate Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices without a build step. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure connectivity via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial experience through guided installation and provider setup for multiple AI backends. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and configuration settings.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This dashboard integrates Hermes Agent with messaging channels like Telegram and Slack while offering a visual workflow canvas with approval gates. It manages local sessions using a self-built SQLite database and includes tools for scheduled jobs and usage analytics.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated skills manager with an MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single collaborative workspace available as a desktop, server, or mobile client. The platform allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent to extend its multi-agent coding environment.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native macOS workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for system repair. It includes native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a specialized kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering alongside tools for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes for site-aware drafting and tab management. It features a Bot Mode that enables multi-agent switching and collaborative threads directly within the browser.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI application for iOS 18+ that connects directly to self-hosted servers without third-party relays. It enables mobile users to drive Hermes agents through real-time chat, task management, and workspace file browsing.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking kanban pipelines. It functions as an MCP server control plane that supports real-time chat with tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live API quota burn and estimated costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs across agent histories without uploading telemetry.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for configuring agent profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA enables Hermes management through Telegram, supporting background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows desktop environment runs via portable Python and Node.js without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for local models, TTS, and ComfyUI, supporting both LM Studio and OpenRouter.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard offers real-time session activity tracking and full inspection of skill source code. It provides read-only access to environment variables and conversation histories to facilitate cost tracking.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first design with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports model switching with streaming SSE responses.
